column2: Strip Artifact before spending your strongest debuff. Every sixth card adds Wither.
If you can reach the Plow threshold, push damage to stun it and clear its Strength.
Your last targeted play changes facing. Face the harder-hitting claw before ending the turn.
For Curse of Knowledge, take the penalty your deck relies on least; protect your draw or energy engine.
While she sleeps, set up powers before dealing HP damage and waking her.
Account for the Torch Head's intent as well as the Queen's. Binding can disrupt the next hand.
Save large single hits for turns without Intangible. Block or set up while it is active.
Breaking a phase isn't winning the fight. Save resources for the revivals.
Check Sandpit before spending all your energy on attacks. Escape before the countdown expires.
Check the Priest and both Followers. Removing an attacking Follower can cut damage this turn.
While Slippery is active, spend small hits on its stacks before your biggest attack.
Save defense for Explode. Check Steam Eruption before committing to a killing blow.
